remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Exchanged in 1972 by O'Keeffe for cat. nos. 823, 824, which had been received in exchange in 1936 by O'Keeffe for cat. no. 725. Titled *Drawing X* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Drawing X

description: In this abstract composition, a large, uneven band of black runs up from the bottom of the work to the top. It takes a slight horizontal turn near the bottom of the work, then resumes its upward trajectory. A smaller black stripe emerges from the wide band and creates an upside-down V-shape at the lower left corner of the composition. The elements appear to cast faint gray shadows against a plain white background.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Museum of Modern Art (MoMA).
title: Drawing X
